titulo_es: Read a story with several past

accumulare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

trasformò.consejo: Third person from the «trasformare» remote passage.

texto: Pay attention to the causes and background: what factors motivated the choice of destiny, what setbacks occurred when travelling and what surprises the final walk had to take.
It identifies the value of expressions such as **nonostante il maltempo** (despite bad weather) or **per caso** (by chance).

frases.it: Quando Laura arrivò alla stazione di Trieste, pioveva e il treno aveva accumulato un'ora di ritardo.
frases.es: Cuando Laura llegó a la estación de Trieste, llovía y el tren había acumulado una hora de retraso.
frases.en: When Laura arrived at the Trieste station, it rained and the train had accumulated an hour of delay.

frases.it: Aveva scelto quella città perché una sua amica le aveva parlato con entusiasmo del porto.
frases.es: Había elegido esa ciudad porque una amiga suya le había hablado con entusiasmo del puerto.
frases.en: He had chosen that city because a friend of his had spoken to him enthusiastically of the port.

frases.it: Lasciò la valigia in albergo e uscì in piazza Unità nonostante il maltempo.
frases.es: Dejó la maleta en el hotel y salió a la plaza Unità a pesar del mal tiempo.
frases.en: He left the suitcase at the hotel and went out to Unità Square despite the bad weather.
analisis: He went out to the Unità Square

frases.it: Lì incontrò per caso un compagno di università che stava aspettando un collega.
frases.es: Allí encontró por casualidad a un compañero de universidad que estaba esperando a un colega.
frases.en: There he found a college partner who was waiting for a colleague.
analisis: I was waiting for a colleague.

frases.it: Dopo aver bevuto un caffè insieme, si scambiarono i numeri e promisero di rivedersi.
frases.es: Después de haber tomado un café juntos, se intercambiaron los números y prometieron volver a verse.
frases.en: After having had a coffee together, the numbers were exchanged and they promised to see each other again.
analisis: dopo aver bevuto un caffè insieme
after having had a coffee together

frases.it: La giornata che sembrava iniziata male si trasformò in un ricordo speciale.
frases.es: El día que parecía haber empezado mal se transformó en un recuerdo especial.
frases.en: The day that it seemed to have started wrong, it became a special memory.
analisis: la giornata che sembrava iniziata male
the day it seemed to have started wrong

bloques.pregunta: What temporary problem had Laura suffered before she arrived in Trieste?

opciones.texto: The train had accumulated an hour of delay during the journey.
opciones.explicacion: The text specifies: «il treno aveva accumulato un'ora di ritardo».

opciones.texto: He lost his suitcase at the train station when he was transshipment.
opciones.explicacion: Laura keeps her luggage and leaves it at the hotel: «lasciò la valigia in albergo».

opciones.texto: All the hotels were cancelled due to the persistent rain.
opciones.explicacion: Laura goes to her hotel normally to stay.

bloques.pregunta: Why had Laura decided to visit the city of Trieste?

opciones.texto: Because a friend of mine had spoken to him with enthusiasm about the attractions of the port.
opciones.explicacion: His previous choice was based on a friend's enthusiastic recommendation.

opciones.texto: Because I had to attend a business meeting with a colleague.
opciones.explicacion: The one who was waiting for a work colleague was his old partner, not Laura.

opciones.texto: Because he lived there for ten years and wanted to go back to his house.
opciones.explicacion: Laura travels as a visitor and stays in a hotel in the city.

bloques.pregunta: What does the «nonostante il maltempo» expression mean in the text?

opciones.texto: Despite poor weather and rain.
opciones.explicacion: «Nonostante» introduces a difficulty that does not prevent the action from going out.

opciones.texto: Thanks to the sunny and peaceful climate he made in the square.
opciones.explicacion: The story highlights that it was raining when it came.

opciones.texto: Because the storm forced all transport to be suspended.
opciones.explicacion: Laura decides to go for a walk despite the rain.

bloques.pregunta: How did the meeting take place between Laura and her former college partner?

opciones.texto: Se encontraron de manera fortuita e imprevista en la plaza Unità.
opciones.explicacion: The text states that the meeting occurred «per caso» (by chance).

opciones.texto: They had agreed to see themselves in a historic coffee from the station.
opciones.explicacion: Neither of us knew in advance that the other would be in town.

opciones.texto: The partner went to find Laura at the door of her hotel.
opciones.explicacion: The partner was in the square waiting for another person (a colleague).

bloques.pregunta: What did Laura and her partner do before she said goodbye?

opciones.texto: They had a coffee together, exchanged phones and promised to see each other again.
opciones.explicacion: They shared a distended conversation and agreed to return to contact.

opciones.texto: They bought books at a bookstore in the center and went to the port for dinner.
opciones.explicacion: They only had a coffee after they met on an unscheduled basis.

opciones.texto: They discussed their old studies and decided to leave without talking.
opciones.explicacion: The meeting was very nice and they promised to see each other again.

bloques.pregunta: What concludes this sentence about Laura's day?
bloques.frase: La giornata che sembrava iniziata male si trasformò in un ricordo speciale.

opciones.texto: That the end of the day was extremely positive despite the initial difficulties.
opciones.explicacion: He overcame the train's delay and the bad weather thanks to the pleasant, fortuitous encounter.

opciones.texto: That Laura was sorry to have traveled to Trieste because of the rain.
opciones.explicacion: It explicitly states that experience became a special memory.

opciones.texto: That the train back was definitely cancelled at night.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase refers to the sentimental and viganal balance of the whole day.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the form of the story.
bloques.frase: Dopo aver bevuto un caffè insieme, Laura e il suo amico si ___ i numeri di telefono.

opciones.texto: scambiarono
opciones.explicacion: Reciprocal verb in remote third person of plural.

opciones.texto: scambiamo
opciones.explicacion: He is the first plural person of the present («intercambiamos»).

opciones.texto: scambiate
opciones.explicacion: He is second person of plural of the present or imperative («intercambiad»).

intro: Read this story set in Trieste carefully. He observed the alternation of verbal times to rebuild the exact chronology of events.
